title: Israel at Mount Sinai

questions.question: Where did the Israelites camp in the third month after leaving Egypt?
options: In the wilderness of Sinai before the mountain
questions.correctAnswer: In the wilderness of Sinai before the mountain
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:1-2 (ESV): "They came into the wilderness of Sinai... and Israel encamped before the mountain."

questions.question: What did God promise Israel would be if they obeyed His voice?
options: A kingdom of priests and a holy nation
questions.correctAnswer: A kingdom of priests and a holy nation
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:6 (ESV): "You shall be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation."

questions.question: What covered Mount Sinai when God descended upon it?
options: Smoke, because the Lord descended on it in fire
questions.correctAnswer: Smoke, because the Lord descended on it in fire
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:18 (ESV): "Mount Sinai was wrapped in smoke because the Lord had descended on it in fire."

questions.question: What were the people told not to do regarding the mountain?
options: Touch the mountain or they would die
questions.correctAnswer: Touch the mountain or they would die
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:12 (ESV): "Whoever touches the mountain shall be put to death."

questions.question: How did God come down to speak to Moses on the mountain?
options: In a thick cloud with thunder and lightning
questions.correctAnswer: In a thick cloud with thunder and lightning
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:16 (ESV): "There were thunders and lightnings and a thick cloud on the mountain."

questions.question: What metaphor did God use for how He brought Israel out of Egypt?
options: I bore you on eagles' wings
questions.correctAnswer: I bore you on eagles' wings
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:4 (ESV): "You yourselves have seen... how I bore you on eagles' wings and brought you to myself."

questions.question: What did the people answer when Moses told them God's words?
options: All that the Lord has spoken we will do
questions.correctAnswer: All that the Lord has spoken we will do
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:8 (ESV): "All the people answered together and said, 'All that the Lord has spoken we will do.'"

questions.question: How were the Israelites to prepare before God appeared?
options: Consecrate themselves and wash their garments
questions.correctAnswer: Consecrate themselves and wash their garments
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:10 (ESV): "Go to the people and consecrate them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments."

questions.question: What sound was heard growing louder and louder on the mountain?
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:19 (ESV): "The sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder."

questions.question: What did the whole mountain do when God descended?
What would happen if anyone or an animal touched the mountain?
options: They would be stoned or shot (not touched)
questions.correctAnswer: They would be stoned or shot (not touched)
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:13 (ESV): "He shall be stoned or shot; whether beast or man, he shall not live."

questions.question: What signal would tell the people they could approach the mountain?
options: When the trumpet sounds a long blast
questions.correctAnswer: When the trumpet sounds a long blast
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:13 (ESV): "When the trumpet sounds a long blast, they shall come up to the mountain."

questions.question: God warned Moses to go down and warn the people a second time. Why?
options: Lest they break through to the Lord to look, and many perish
questions.correctAnswer: Lest they break through to the Lord to look, and many perish
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:21 (ESV): "Go down and warn the people, lest they break through to the Lord to look and many of them perish."

questions.question: Who were also told to consecrate themselves lest the Lord break out against them?
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:22 (ESV): "Also let the priests who come near to the Lord consecrate themselves, lest the Lord break out against them."

questions.question: What did God call Israel in relation to all the earth?
options: His treasured possession out of all peoples
questions.correctAnswer: His treasured possession out of all peoples
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:5 (ESV): "You shall be my treasured possession among all peoples, for all the earth is mine."

key_verse_text: Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice and keep my covenant, you shall be my treasured possession among all peoples...and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.
